Before you do a campus visit, narrow down your list of target colleges to 4-9 schools. In the mix should be your “safety” or regional schools, as well as some reach ones. You’ll go on campus visits for your regional schools. Only go on campus visits for a reach school if you’ve gotten into them.&nbsp;
